links.outcome: Model performance and fairness across SDoH, age, and race subgroups
links.effect: Disparities in model performance across SDoH subgroups, but minimal disparities across age or race subgroups.
links.quote: Fairness evaluations revealed disparities in model performance across SDoH subgroups, but minimal disparities across age or race subgroups.

unlisted_practices: Clinician review of top statistically correlated and ML-important features for expected clinical associations
Post-hoc interpretability analysis of feature importance versus feature availability

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates predictive risk models for maternal health events using the All of Us dataset, including post-hoc interpretability, clinician feature review, and fairness/disparity analysis across SDoH subgroups, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
